eras.summary: Cloudflare shipped Workers CPU/runtime improvements covering request scheduling under CPU bursts, V8 garbage collection settings, OpenNext buffer copies, stream high-watermarks, V8 JSON.parse behavior, Node.js math behavior, and framework benchmark configuration fixes.
benchmarkImpact: Do not compare pre- and post-era CPU-heavy SSR results as equivalent runtime conditions.
Keep OpenNext and Node compatibility versions in result provenance when interpreting Next.js rows.

eras.summary: Cloudflare cache is powered by Pingora, including async stale-while-revalidate and unbuffered bypass behavior.
benchmarkImpact: Record cache-control, cf-cache-status, age, and date headers for live rows.
Treat cache-era differences as benchmark provenance for TTFB and cache-hit interpretation.
